modelSettings.title: Models and services
modelSettings.description: Configure separate services for material analysis, copywriting, and speech synthesis.
modelSettings.localSaveHint: Settings are saved on this device
modelSettings.analysisDescription: Analyze sampled video frames, scene content, and shot order.
modelSettings.reuseCopywritingModel: Reuse the copywriting model for video analysis
modelSettings.reuseCopywritingHint: Video analysis uses the model configured on the Copywriting tab. Make sure it accepts image input.
modelSettings.visionModelHint: Choose a model that accepts image input and enter the model ID provided by your service account.
modelSettings.copywritingDescription: Generate narration from the platform, target duration, and creative brief.
modelSettings.ttsDescription: Configure Edge TTS or a MiniMax system voice. Loading MiniMax voices requires a network connection.
modelSettings.ttsNotReady: Voice settings are still loading. Please try again in a moment.
modelSettings.providerNote: Presets fill common API URLs and protocols. Check your provider console for model IDs, regions, and supported features. Video analysis requires image input support. A test sends a short text request and may retry on network errors; charges depend on the provider.
modelSettings.invalidConfig: Check the API URL, protocol, and model ID.

config.invalidApiUrl: Invalid API base URL. Use http:// or https:// and remove query strings, fragments, and embedded credentials.
config.fullEndpointApiUrl: Enter the API base URL without the complete API endpoint path.
config.invalidTimeoutSeconds: Timeout must be a positive whole number of seconds.
config.invalidMaxOutputTokens: Maximum output tokens must be a positive whole number or left empty.
config.builtinDescription: Use built-in voiceover rules to generate text ready for speech synthesis.
config.customDescription: Use your complete custom prompt instead of the built-in rules.
config.offDescription: Do not add a system prompt; send only the creative request.
config.customPromptHint: The custom content completely replaces the built-in prompt.
config.diversityDescription: Rotate creative angles and refer to recent scripts to vary openings and structure. Explicit user requirements remain authoritative. Limited history stays on this device; a few text excerpts are sent to the selected provider during generation.
config.rewriteOnSimilarity: Rewrite once when highly similar copy is detected
config.rewriteDescription: A rewrite usually adds one generation call; network retries may make the actual request count higher, increasing cost and latency.
config.clearHistoryConfirm: Clear locally stored recent scripts and strategy rotation history?
config.samplingDescription: Leave empty to use model defaults. Usually adjust either Temperature or Top P, not both. Supported ranges vary by model.
config.samplingCompatibilityUnknown: Compatibility cannot be inferred from protocol alone. Check the provider and model documentation; unsupported parameters may cause request failures.
config.invalidTemperature: Temperature must be a finite number from 0 to 2, or empty. A specific model may support a narrower range.
config.invalidTopP: Top P must be a finite number from 0 to 1, or empty.
config.replacePromptConfirm: This will replace the current custom prompt. Continue?
config.invalidHeaderName: Invalid header name. Use a standard HTTP header name.
config.invalidHeaderValue: Header values cannot contain control characters or line breaks.
config.protectedHeaderName: This header is managed by the protocol or authentication and cannot be customized.
